headlines.title: For alpha-gal patients, allergy drug could cut the severity of reactions to red meat
headlines.description: There’s emerging evidence that the allergy drug omalizumab may reduce severe allergic reactions for alpha-gal syndrome, a red meat allergy triggered by a tick bite.

headlines.title: New prostate cancer screening guidelines include regular PSA testing for most older men
headlines.description: As rates of advanced prostate cancer rise, the American Cancer Society is recommending that most men age 50 to 69 get a PSA blood test every other year.

headlines.title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke
headlines.description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: How to Protect Your Eyes During the Cold Months
headlines.description: Cold weather can impact eye health so as winter nears, Dr. Tamiesha Frempong, a pediatric ophthalmologist for Mount Sinai Health System in New York City, joins TODAY with steps to protect your eyes. Tips include wearing UV-blocking sunglasses for snow glare, using lubricating eyedrops for combating dry eyes caused by indoor heating systems, and more.

headlines.title: What to Know About New Prostate Cancer Screening Guidelines
headlines.description: The American Cancer Society is making changes to major guidelines regarding prostate cancer screenings, including a recommendation for more routine testing. These changes come as prostate cancer cases have risen at an alarming rate. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Akshay Syal joins TODAY to break down what men need to know about these changes.

headlines.title: NBC News' Chloe Melas gets candid about gut health in her new book ‘The Girl’s Guide to Guts’
headlines.description: NBC News' Chloe Melas addresses gut health in her new book, ‘The Girl’s Guide to Guts,’ aiming to reduce stigma following her inflammatory bowel disease diagnosis.

headlines.title: Measles cases explode amid declining vaccination rates
headlines.description: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin traveled to Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, which is the epicenter of a deadly measles outbreak. The investigative report for the NBC News series “The Vaccine Divide” finds 75% of U.S. counties have vaccination rates that are now below the level needed for herd immunity.

headlines.title: This cleansing balm can ‘remove even the toughest oil-based colorful makeup’ and it’s 30% off
headlines.description: The Banila Co cleansing balm can remove stubborn makeup, dirt and waterproof products. It’s currently 30% off and at its lowest price in 90 days; it’s a great stocking stuffer for a beauty lover.

headlines.title: 67+ Indigenous-owned brands that should be on your radar
headlines.description: We rounded up a list of Indigenous-owned brands we think you should know about across food, jewelry, beauty and more.

headlines.title: Can water flossers replace dental floss? Here’s what dentists say
headlines.description: Are water flossers as effective as dental floss? Dentists explain, and share how to properly use them.

headlines.title: How to build an emergency car kit that actually helps when you’re stuck
headlines.description: Learn what to put in your winter car kit, plus shop pre-made kits and supplies like jump starters, flashlights, tire chains and more.
